card.name: Split-off T before THERAPY, and herbicide words
card.fires_on: Mainly a lone capital T right before HERAPY in all-caps warnings (PENICILLIN T|HERAPY). Also fires on words just before a predicted 'her...' word like herbicides or HER2.

modes.label: T before HERAPY
modes.description: The letter T split off from THERAPY in all-caps label warnings, after a drug or treatment word.
modes.example: REACTIONS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN PATIENTS ON PENICILLIN<< T>>HERAPY. THESE REACTIONS

modes.label: Before herbicide or HER2 words
modes.description: A word or comma in pesticide text or HER2 cancer text, where the next word begins with 'her'.
modes.example: Paraquat, one of the most widely<< used>> herbicides in the world, is so

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'her' and similar pronoun pieces, and away from word pieces like 'er' and 'Herb'.
card.plain: It fires when the next piece of text is likely to start with 'her', as in THERAPY, herbicide or HER2.
